model.title: To require the Commissioner of U.S. Customs and Border Protection to link together applications of family members throughout the NEXUS application process, and for other purposes.
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Homeland Security Committee · Rep. Timothy Kennedy (D-NY)

summary.text: The bill would require U.S. Customs and Border Protection to allow family members applying for NEXUS—an expedited border inspection program between the United States and Canada—to link their applications together. It would let one family member schedule interviews for all linked relatives and give them the option to participate in joint interviews, while potentially allowing children under 14 to skip the interview requirement if linked to an eligible family member.
